title: (OPT) Share checked HIR across cache lookup and core retention without deep copies
body:
## Problem
CheckedModule in src/project/incremental.rs owns full resolved HIR. checked_module warm hits deep-clone entry.resolved (~499), and cold insertion deep-clones resolved (~556). Arc<CheckedModule> shares the cache container while the core still receives a separate HIR copy.

This is a semantic-cache opportunity. It cannot by itself cure the uncached Shift forecast refusal. retain_module already moves filtered HIR and retained_vectors already reuses exact full carriers; do not duplicate those improvements.

## Scope
Use an internal shared checked-HIR owner and exact local-function/type selection views. Final owned public/link products materialize only at their genuine owning boundary. Returning Arc then cloning in retain_workspace_module is insufficient.

Preserve full HIR/association verification, source pointers, complete synthetic/environment cache keys, source drift refusal and cold-equivalent semantic debits. Forged cache bytes remain untrusted. Update PROJECT-SEMANTIC-CACHE-V1's explicit clone contract and mode-seven two-bundle physical forecast only after proving actual shared lifetime and eliminating the copies. Keep all limits and canonical cleanup sequences.

## Required evidence
Independent old owned outputs and full persisted wire parity; actual cold insertion/warm lookup/core retention/final publication/Drop allocation witnesses. Exact/one-short capacity, sticky failure, current-source and environment drift, forged loan/layout/association metadata, complete revalidation and stale-cache rejection. Original persisted RequestViews, private-layout warm-reuse and full application controls. Report private/cache-only evidence honestly; no token advantage headline without matched live agents.
